mapper.select: select * from walk_score_summary where activity_id = #{activityId} and member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: update walk_score_summary s set s.total_score = ( select coalesce(sum(score_value), 0) from walk_score_record where member_id = s.member_id and activity_id = s.activity_id ), s.update_time = sysdate() where s.activity_id = #{activityId} and s.member_id = #{memberId}
